g.aria-label: The OCC is the heart of Afrikaburn, and where you’ll most likely ﬁnd essential services and information. It’s also the bustling core of volunteering, so come sign up for some shifts - Afrikaburn only works as a communal project!

Please keep your nice car parked after your arrival. No, *just* going to pick up ice is not an emergency. Please leave the roads clear for pedestrians, essential services and mutant vehicles who’ve made a point to dress up for the occasion.

g.aria-label: There is a guide to the various sound zones in the WTF Guide. You should read that. In general, let’s all try not to be kak, and be lekker and considerate. There are however two dedicated ʻ Quieter/st Zones’ which we ask folks to respect: ﬁrst, behind the dunes between �ish and �ish, and second, around the temple . Finally, AfrikaBurn, the event (and all the sound), closes at midnight on Sunday, so everyone can get a good night’s sleep before the journey home. Again, please respect that for everyone’s sanity and safety!
